title: Add GitHub pre-release publication flow

context.summary: Publish tag-built release artifacts as public GitHub pre-releases instead of draft-only releases.
context.background: TASK-118 aligned public docs with the current runtime baseline. The next release-readiness step is making the release workflow and docs describe a public pre-release flow while keeping the final full-public gate for later tasks.

in: Update the GitHub release workflow so tag builds create or update public pre-releases.
Keep release artifacts signed and checksummed with release download URLs under the version tag.
Update release checklist, deployment, production hardening, support matrix and release notes wording from draft release to pre-release.
Update release validation so it asserts pre-release publication behavior.
Document that draft is only an optional manual staging state before tag publication.
out: Publishing the existing v0.1.0 draft release manually.
Changing release signing keys or secrets.
Adding published-release bootstrap acceptance; that is TASK-120.

acceptance_criteria: Release workflow uses public pre-release flags for tag-built GitHub releases.
Release workflow no longer creates or updates tag-built GitHub releases as drafts.
Release docs and checklist describe pre-release contents and pre-release publication behavior.
Generated release notes mention that the workflow publishes a GitHub pre-release for trusted tag builds.
Release workflow validation checks the pre-release behavior.
pnpm release:validate, pnpm public:validate, pnpm tasks:validate and pnpm check pass before merge.

manual_checks: Confirm no task publishes or edits the live GitHub release directly.
Confirm public docs do not still describe tag-built artifacts as draft releases.

risks: Changing release publication flags incorrectly could leave a tag release as draft or omit the pre-release marker.
definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
